title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. ESTABLISH a Life of Project (LOP) Budget for Astoria and Polk At-Grade Crossing Improvements within Segment 4…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0640, Project]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to:

A.	ESTABLISH a Life of Project (LOP) Budget for Astoria and Polk At-Grade Crossing Improvements within Segment 4 of the Brighton to Roxford Double Track Project in the amount of $27,617,625 to advance construction; and

B.	NEGOTIATE AND EXECUTE all project-related contracts, modifications, and agreements within the authorized LOP Budget.
summary: Metro would set a $27.6 million budget for building the Astoria and Polk at-grade crossing improvements in Segment 4 of the Brighton to Roxford Double Track project so construction can proceed.
